profile.title: AI Builder, Individual Contributor, & Technical Management

intro.text: As a proven developer, I have successfully shipped over 20 products using C++, with additional projects in C#, Unity 3D, and Java, encompassing areas such as embedded systems, IoT, and cloud computing. My technical proficiency is complemented by a strong patent portfolio that includes more than 20 patents in consumer device technology, natural interaction, and complex 3D game engine architecture, underscoring my capability to deliver pioneering and strategic solutions in technology development.

My development background is extensive, with a deep understanding of algorithms, design patterns, and multiple programming languages. I have focused for 25+ years on C++ and have significant experience in Python, Swift, & C#. I have pioneered 9 version-1 devices and numerous non-device products, achieving substantial market adoption. My work in AI and machine learning has spanned estimation, prediction, and advanced neural network applications, including DNNs, CNNs, DCGANs, and time-series analysis with LSTMs.

Throughout my career, I have held pivotal management roles, from leading small teams of three developers to directing groups of up to 70. My leadership tenure includes 16 years in engineering management from Manager to Vice President, during which I developed a robust methodology in change management, team building, and performance coaching. This experience has enabled me to foster a bottom-up culture in engineering that emphasizes mission-driven results and consistently yields high year-over-year developer retention rates.

I have extensive experience with desktop, mobile, and cloud platforms in technical environments, having contributed to 5 major cloud-based products over 9 years. My architectural expertise includes systems design, reliability, and maintainability across various platforms, from embedded systems to cloud infrastructure.

I am passionately driven by the opportunities at the intersection of AI, spatial computing, and ubiquitous computing, continually seeking to push the boundaries of what is possible in technology development.

As a proven developer and engineering leader, I have successfully shipped over 20 innovative products spanning areas such as spatial computing, embedded systems, IoT, and cloud computing. My expertise in gesture interfaces for Kinect Xbox, spatial audio, and audio synthesis highlights my ability to enhance user interactions through cutting-edge technology. I have a strong track record in developing pioneering and strategic solutions in technology development.

My development background is extensive, with a deep understanding of algorithms, design patterns, and system architecture. I have led the creation of 9 version-1 devices and numerous non-device products, achieving substantial market adoption. I have specialized in the applied use of AI and machine learning for tracking, segmentation, and depth, with hands-on study and implementation of DNNs, CNNs, DCGANs, and time-series analysis with LSTMs using C++ and Python across various ML tool chains.

I have spearheaded the development of spatial computing platforms, including the award-winning Lightship ARDK and Magic Leap's AR collaboration tools, enhancing user interaction through cutting-edge technologies. My leadership in developing and optimizing 3D graphics pipelines, system software, and user experience frameworks has driven the success of multiple high-profile projects. My expertise in rapid prototyping, API and framework creation, and cross-functional collaboration ensures the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and user-centric products. Additionally, I have specialized in heterogeneous optimization into parallel chips for head-mounted displays (HMD), automotive systems, and game consoles. My deep understanding of human ergonomics and psychoacoustics further enhances the development of intuitive and effective spatial interactions.

Primarily focused on top performing VisionOS volumetric spatial sports experiences for the past 2 years. With zero team growth, I have been able to focus most of the time on developing the performance-critical platform components. These include real-time graphics streaming, rendering, caching, and developer acceleration tools. I have been deeply immersed in Swift, SwiftUI, RealityKit, and Instruments in addition to building tools to track down specific performance and reliability challenges on the VisionOS platform.

I am a natural hands-on leader, using engineering principles to influence team productivity and direction. I work closely with executive leadership, product teams, UX teams, etc. to ensure the whole organization moves efficiently towards product delivery.
I'm humble, able to adapt quickly to new situations, and happily follow as well as lead. I carry deep motivations to create amazing products and experiences.

inventions.title: Eclipse Cursor for Virtual Content in Mixed Reality Displays
inventions.summary: A cursor system designed specifically for mixed-reality environments where virtual content is layered over the real world. The system dynamically adjusts cursor appearance and interaction behavior depending on depth, occlusion, and visual context. The "eclipse" metaphor allows the cursor to partially mask or highlight objects so users can accurately target virtual elements without losing situational awareness of the real environment.

inventions.title: Multiple VPS Synchronization for Live Spatial Event Viewing
inventions.summary: An AR system that combines multiple spatial registrations or coordinate systems to accurately place virtual overlays during live events. By blending different tracking sources—camera tracking, venue models, broadcast feeds—the system improves stability and alignment of AR graphics displayed to viewers.

inventions.title: Spatial Dynamic Adjustment of User Interface
inventions.summary: Adapts graphical user interfaces dynamically based on user behavior, context, and interaction state. UI elements may resize, reposition, or change functionality depending on how the user interacts with the system, improving usability across devices and input methods.

inventions.title: Ergonomic Physical Interaction Zone Cursor Mapping
inventions.summary: Maps physical hand movement zones to cursor motion in a way that reduces fatigue and improves precision. The system adjusts the control mapping to match ergonomic interaction zones, supporting natural input devices such as motion controllers or touchless sensors.

inventions.title: Spatial Target and Press Natural User Input
inventions.summary: A natural interaction model where users target objects and perform press-like gestures without physical buttons. The system interprets gestures and motion patterns as virtual presses to interact with UI elements.

inventions.title: Motion Effect Reduction for Displays and Touch Input
inventions.summary: Reduces motion artifacts that occur when users interact with displays during movement. It compensates for visual latency and touch input discrepancies to maintain stable interaction in mobile or head-tracked displays.

inventions.title: Spatial Multiuser Session Manager
inventions.summary: A session management framework for shared AR/XR experiences. It coordinates device connections, shared state synchronization, participant roles, and spatial anchors across multiple users. The system ensures consistency of virtual objects and collaborative interactions across devices in a distributed mixed-reality session.

inventions.title: Spatial 3D Multi-Machine Tool Bridge
inventions.summary: An architecture for connecting authoring tools and runtime XR systems. It allows developers to build content in familiar tools (e.g., game engines or 3D editors) and synchronize that content with real-time XR environments. The bridge manages data conversion, asset updates, and live preview workflows.

inventions.title: Spatial 3D Object Multiuser Annotation
inventions.summary: Techniques for anchoring annotations to real-world 3D objects. The system enables users to attach metadata, comments, or instructions to physical objects within spatial computing systems. These annotations remain spatially aligned as users move around the object and can be shared across collaborators.

inventions.title: Locating Friends Within Venue in an Augmented Reality System
inventions.summary: A system that enables real-time spatial discovery of friends inside large venues using AR overlays. The platform tracks user locations and renders directional indicators or avatars within an augmented reality view, allowing users to locate each other inside environments such as stadiums or events without needing traditional maps.

inventions.title: Spatial Immersive Audio Platform
inventions.summary: A platform for spatial audio rendering in immersive environments. It dynamically generates directional sound fields, reverberation, and spatial cues so audio behaves consistently with the user's position and environment. The platform supports large multi-user XR experiences and immersive media playback.

inventions.title: Spatial-Aware Reverberation from World Geometry
inventions.summary: Automatically computes environmental reverberation effects based on 3D game geometry. By analyzing the shapes and materials of virtual spaces, the system generates realistic acoustic reflections without manual tuning by audio designers.

inventions.title: Spatial Device Pairing with a Tracking System
inventions.summary: Enables portable devices to pair automatically with external tracking systems. Once paired, the device can use the tracking data to align virtual content or synchronize interaction across devices.

inventions.title: Establishment of Pairing Between Communication Devices
inventions.summary: Simplifies pairing between multiple devices by automating the discovery and authentication process. It reduces manual configuration steps and allows devices to establish secure communication relationships dynamically.

inventions.title: Systems and Methods for Creating and Managing GUI Lists
inventions.summary: A framework for managing graphical user interface lists efficiently. It includes techniques for dynamic list rendering, data management, and interactive scrolling behavior for complex UI environments.

inventions.title: Selective Placement of Movable GUI Objects
inventions.summary: Allows users to reposition interface elements within constrained layouts. The method defines rules for placement so objects remain organized and visually coherent when moved.

inventions.title: Tiered UI Scaling Based on Display Dimensions
inventions.summary: A scalable UI layout system where interface components adjust automatically based on display size and resolution. Objects follow tiered scaling rules to preserve usability across devices.

inventions.title: Interaction with Controllable GUI Objects
inventions.summary: Methods for interacting with graphical interface elements using multiple input devices such as keyboard, mouse, or alternative controllers.

inventions.title: Manipulating User Interface Controls
inventions.summary: Techniques for manipulating interface controls within a GUI environment. Provides a generalized interaction framework for activating, modifying, and controlling UI components.
